title: fal Adds Image-to-3D Generator Idol to AI Platform
summary:
The AI platform fal now supports the generation of 3D Gaussian splats using the Idol model, allowing users to convert a single image into a 3D object in about 10 seconds. The integration enables customizable output density from 32K to 1M Gaussians and provides exports in .ply and .glb formats for 3D rendering.

Developed by Sperid Labs, Idol is an open-source 3D-DiT model with 600M parameters, accessible under the Apache 2.0 license. The tool is designed to operate on consumer GPUs requiring less than 7.2 GB of VRAM, and a demo version is currently available on Hugging Face.
